cases.sentence: Затем я увидел другого ___, спускающегося с небес.
cases.explain: «могучего ангела» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

cases.sentence: Его лицо было как солнце, а ноги — как ___ .
cases.explain: «огненные столбы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

cases.sentence: Я взял ___ из руки ангела и съел его: во рту он был сладким, как мед, но в желудке потом была от него горечь .
cases.explain: «маленький свиток» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.
